Qview changelog

[1.0.0]

Added
  Live markdown rendering with four document themes
  Tabs with session restore, favorites for files and folders
  Fullscreen image viewer with persistent fit modes
  PDF and video preview
  Inline edit mode with save to disk

Changed
  Third-party libraries are vendored locally, so the app works offline

[0.9.0]

Added
  First working tree, renderer and file watcher
